marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 15 knots early Thursday
morning then veering to south 15 to 20 late Thursday morning. Wind increasing to
west 30 early Thursday afternoon. Scattered flurries Thursday afternoon and evening. Fog
patches forming after midnight and dissipating Thursday morning. Visibility 1
mile or less in fog patches and as low as 1 mile in
flurries. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to south 15 knots late overnight and to
west 35 near noon Thursday. Wind diminishing to west 20 to 25 Thursday
evening. Scattered flurries Thursday afternoon and evening.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in flurries. Low tonight minus 3. High Thursday plus 2. <br/>
